description: Set up Authenticode code signing for the Windows installer, portable exe, and helper binary. Options: EV certificate (hardware token) for immediate SmartScreen trust, or OV certificate (cheaper, builds reputation over time). Configure electron-builder's win.certificateFile/certificatePassword or signtool integration. CI/CD signs during build via environment secrets. Sign both the inner exe and the NSIS installer wrapper.
title: Windows code signing
